policy.initialization: Generic LAION CLIP text embeddings initialize the head; every head is then trained on labelled vehicle images. No untrained zero-shot answer is deployed.
policy.selection: Validation only: .5 whole macro + .2 synthetic-phone macro + .3 priority-make whole macro; old historical validation within 2 percentage points
policy.data: Frozen multimodal_v24 dataset and source/session splits. 18 manually verified private training crops; no unverified AI labels. Existing reported errors excluded from fitting. No filename features.
policy.calibration: Per-make validation precision >=90%, >=3 source groups, confidence >=.5, margin >=.06, minimum view dimension 40 pixels
policy.test_warning: Existing public heldouts have been used in earlier iterations and are not a fresh blind Uzbekistan field trial. No epoch or threshold reselection after this fixed model is tested.
policy.stopping: Stop after these two fits; reject failed candidates without lowering release guards or starting an endless search. Existing 2.2 release remains intact.
